From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: DataForge pricing request — need quick pricing play

Team — forwarding the DataForge request. Key asks: 1. worked cost example for 1.2 TB/day raw ingest -> assume 50% effective after sampling/compression (we can parameterize) — looking for a conservative and an aggressive scenario; 2. 90 day retention for traces; 3. 25 seat dashboard bundle (20 viewers, 5 editors); 4. ask for 12-month commit and potential onboarding credit.

My initial thinking:
- Storage: show both hot-tier (90-day) and cold-tier (archival) options. Hot-tier pricing: $0.045/GB-month; cold-tier: $0.006/GB-month (if they choose on-prem archival integration, price clears as project professional services + reduced cold-tier storage).
- Tracing ingest: charge per million spans equivalent — propose blended rate that gives ~18% discount at $250k ARR commit.
- Dashboards: seat bundle MSRP $1,500/editor/mo, $150/viewer/mo; for 12mo commit propose 20% off net on seats + one-time $25k onboarding credit for migration + 3 months free on retention storage.

Can we run a quick calc with Naomi to validate numbers and produce the sample invoice + SOW? I want to offer a structured discount (tiered) rather than a flat concession.

Thanks,
Avery

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DataForge pricing request — need quick pricing play

Avery / Karthik — ran the numbers in the pricing model (attached). Summary for the conservative scenario (50% compression):

- Ingest: 1.2 TB/day raw -> 600 GB/day effective -> ~18 TB/month. Ingest processing & trace credit: $15,300/mo.
- Hot retention (90 days): storage needed ~54 TB active -> $2,430/mo at $0.045/GB-month.
- Dashboards seats: 5 editors x $1,200 = $6,000/mo (20% committed discount applied); 20 viewers x $120 = $2,400/mo -> total seats $8,400/mo.
- One-time onboarding credit: offer $25,000 (applied against first 3 invoices).

Net monthly recurring (after seat discounts, before onboarding credit amortization): $26,130/mo -> ~$313,560/year. With our proposed 12-month commit concession (18% blended discount on ingest + storage), net annual ARR ~ $257,000.

Recommended commercial offer to send:
1) Pilot PO: 3 months at 50% of monthly run-rate (allows them to validate ingest & dashboards)
2) Enterprise SOW: 12-month commit at the blended discount above + $25k onboarding credit + optional on-prem archival integration priced as professional services (estimate $40k one-time).

I'll attach the pricing workbook and a simple sample SOW and sample invoice PDF. If you want, I can redact and we can push the signed SOW + pricing to DocuSign link for Elena.

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Customer Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference
